title: Shadow zsh formulae removed (about
notes: 5 MiB; the point was the shadowing, not the space).
- Note for future shell checks: `.zshrc` takes an early agent path when
`CLAUDECODE`, `CODEX_AGENT` and similar are set, so a shell started from an
agent session loads none of this. Verify with those variables unset, under
a pty, or the result is a false negative.
result: `.zshrc` sets `ZSH_THEME="powerlevel10k/powerlevel10k"` and lists `zsh-syntax-highlighting` and `zsh-autosuggestions` in `plugins=(...)`, all resolved from `~/.oh-my-zsh/custom`; nothing sourced `/opt/homebrew/share/zsh-*` and no formula depended on the three. After `brew uninstall --formula powerlevel10k zsh-autosuggestions zsh-syntax-highlighting` a real interactive shell still reports `theme=powerlevel10k/powerlevel10k`, both plugins loaded and the `p10k` function present.
